process_area.title: Energy Audit, Measurement & Conservation Plan Management

value_stream.name: Energy Efficiency, Conservation & RA 11285 Compliance Program

fields.Participants: EEO, Facilities (links to VS-20.3), DOE-accredited Energy Auditor/Firm, Compliance (links to VS-22), Sustainability (links to VS-25), Procurement (links to VS-34), Records (links to VS-88)
fields.Trigger: RA 11285 audit cycle (Type-1 every 3 yrs; Type-2 annually for largest consumers); designation (W3738)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-schedule of "schedule per RA 11285 cycle per designated site/entity, select a DOE-accredited…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documentation, and operational context" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "EEO/Compliance submit the audit report and certification to DOE" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-138 (ensure RA 11285 energy compliance & M&V integrity.)
- operational: cycle tracking (W3738); operational: audit not conducted within the cycle → DOE non-compliance; operational: DOE-accreditation and scope
Pain Points / Risks: - **Audit-overdue risk**: Mandatory audit not conducted within the cycle → DOE non-compliance; mitigated by cycle tracking (W3738)
- **Auditor-quality risk**: Weak audit misses ECMs; mitigated by DOE-accreditation and scope
System Touchpoints: - Facilities (links to VS-20.3); procurement (links to VS-34); compliance (links to VS-22); energy data (links to W3741); records (links to VS-88); conservation plan (links to W3748)

steps.activity: EEO/Facilities/Procurement plan and source the mandatory energy audit: schedule per RA 11285 cycle per designated site/entity, select a DOE-accredited energy auditor/firm, scope the audit (Type-1 walk-through / Type-2 detailed), and contract (links to VS-34)

EEO/Facilities support the energy audit: provide consumption data (links to W3741), facility access, system documentation, and operational context; coordinate with store/DC teams (links to VS-07/VS-04); manage audit findings

EEO/Compliance submit the audit report and certification to DOE per the IRR, manage any DOE follow-up, archive to records (links to VS-88/W3744), and feed findings/ECMs to the conservation plan (W3748) and ECM pipeline (W3749)

fields.Participants: EEO, Facilities (links to VS-20.3), Energy Consultant/Auditor, Store Ops (links to VS-07), DC Ops (links to VS-04), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Sustainability (links to VS-25), PMO (links to VS-112)
fields.Trigger: ECM pipeline need; major system replacement; conservation plan (W3748)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify and quantify ECMs" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-renew of "evaluate ECMs" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "feed the ECM pipeline to business-case/investment governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-138 (ensure RA 11285 energy compliance & M&V integrity.)
- operational: investment-grade depth; operational: remodel integration
Pain Points / Risks: - **ECM-miss risk**: IGA too shallow to find deeper ECMs; mitigated by investment-grade depth
- **Integration-miss risk**: ECMs done standalone vs bundled into remodel → higher cost; mitigated by remodel integration
System Touchpoints: - Facilities (links to VS-20.3); store ops (links to VS-07); DC ops (links to VS-04); finance (links to VS-17.4); sustainability (links to VS-25); PMO (links to VS-112); store remodel (links to VS-109)

steps.activity: EEO/Facilities/Energy Consultant conduct investment-grade energy audits (IGA) beyond the statutory minimum: detailed analysis of significant energy uses (HVAC, refrigeration, lighting, process), identify and quantify ECMs (savings, cost, payback, GHG), and develop the ECM register per site

EEO/Facilities evaluate ECMs: technical feasibility, interaction/sequence, risk, and the prioritized ECM pipeline; integrate with facility-renewal/store-remodel plans (links to VS-20.3/VS-109) to bundle energy work into capital projects

EEO/Sustainability feed the ECM pipeline to business-case/investment governance (W3749) and the conservation plan (W3748); track ECMs from identification to delivery (W3753) and verify savings (W3747)

fields.Participants: EEO, Sustainability (links to VS-25), Facilities (links to VS-20.3), BI (links to VS-28.1), Finance (links to VS-17.4), PMO (links to VS-112), Store Ops (links to VS-07)
fields.Volume: M&V per ECM; ongoing performance tracking

workflows.name: Measurement & Verification (M&V) and Energy Performance Tracking

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measurement plan, adjustment for variables" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track energy performance continuously" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "verify and report savings" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-138 (ensure RA 11285 energy compliance & M&V integrity.)
- operational: M&V protocol; operational: continuous tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Savings-uncertainty risk**: Savings not measured/verified, business case unconfirmed; mitigated by M&V protocol
- **Performance-drift risk**: ECM savings degrade over time; mitigated by continuous tracking
System Touchpoints: - Energy data (links to W3741); BI (links to VS-28.1); facilities (links to VS-20.3); finance (links to VS-17.4); ESG/GHG (links to VS-25); benefits realization (links to VS-112.3); analytics (links to W3756)

steps.activity: EEO/Sustainability establish M&V protocols per ECM (IPMVP-aligned): baseline, the measurement plan, adjustment for variables (weather, occupancy, sales volume), and the verification period to confirm realized savings vs business case

EEO/BI track energy performance continuously: monitor EnPIs (kWh/sqm, kWh/revenue, cost) against baseline and target (W3740), detect performance drift, and identify under-performing sites/ECMs for action

EEO/Finance/Sustainability verify and report savings: confirm realized kWh/PHP/GHG savings, report to benefits realization (links to VS-112.3), FP&A (links to VS-17.4), ESG/GHG accounting (links to VS-25/W192/W3466), and program analytics (links to W3756)

fields.Participants: EEO, Compliance (links to VS-22), Sustainability (links to VS-25), Facilities (links to VS-20.3), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Records (links to VS-88)
fields.Trigger: RA 11285 conservation-plan obligation; audit (W3745); annual cycle

workflows.name: Energy Conservation Plan Development & DOE Submission

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitoring/reporting approach, and the resources/timeline" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review/feedback, and maintain the plan current with audit findings" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "EEO/Compliance track ECP execution vs plan, report conservation-plan status" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-590 (ensure controlled execution — Energy Audit, Measurement & Conservation Plan Management (PA-120.2).)
- operational: deadline tracking (W3738); operational: execution tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Plan-not-submitted risk**: ECP not filed → DOE non-compliance; mitigated by deadline tracking (W3738)
- **Plan-vs-execution gap risk**: Plan filed but not executed; mitigated by execution tracking
System Touchpoints: - Compliance (links to VS-22); sustainability (links to VS-25); facilities (links to VS-20.3); legal (links to VS-100.3); records (links to VS-88); cross-entity (links to VS-72); audit (links to VS-21)

steps.activity: EEO/Compliance/Sustainability develop the Energy Conservation Plan (ECP) per RA 11285: the energy-performance baseline, targets, the ECM program (W3746/W3749), the operational/behavioral measures (W3750/W3751), the monitoring/reporting approach, and the resources/timeline
EEO/Compliance submit the ECP to DOE per the IRR, manage DOE review/feedback, and maintain the plan current with audit findings (W3745) and business change; coordinate cross-entity (links to VS-72)
EEO/Compliance track ECP execution vs plan, report conservation-plan status and progress to governance (links to W3737/VS-22) and audit (links to VS-21), and archive to records (links to VS-88/W3744)

fields.Participants: EEO, Finance (links to VS-40/VS-17.4), Facilities (links to VS-20.3), Procurement (links to VS-34), Sustainability (links to VS-25), PMO (links to VS-112), Treasury (links to VS-18), Executive (links to VS-33)

workflows.name: ECM Business Case, Prioritization & Investment Decision

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-renew of "EEO/Finance/Executive prioritize the ECM portfolio against capex envelope" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-submit of "submit ECM projects through capex approval" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-590 (ensure controlled execution — Energy Audit, Measurement & Conservation Plan Management (PA-120.2).)
- operational: M&V (W3747) and conservative case; operational: remodel integration
Pain Points / Risks: - **Weak-business-case risk**: ECM approved on optimistic savings; mitigated by M&V (W3747) and conservative case
- **Bundling-miss risk**: ECM done standalone vs in remodel → higher cost; mitigated by remodel integration
System Touchpoints: - Finance/capex (links to VS-40/VS-17.4); facilities (links to VS-20.3); procurement (links to VS-34); PMO (links to VS-112); store remodel (links to VS-109); benefits realization (links to VS-112.3)

steps.activity: EEO/Finance build the ECM business case per project: capital cost, annual kWh/PHP savings, payback/IRR/NPV, GHG reduction, co-benefits (maintenance, comfort, ESG), and risk; standardize the ECM business-case template

EEO/Finance/Executive prioritize the ECM portfolio against capex envelope (W3743), strategic targets (W3740), and risk; sequence by ROI/strategic value and bundle with facility-renewal/store-remodel (links to VS-109) where efficient
EEO/Finance/PMO submit ECM projects through capex approval (links to VS-40) and stage-gate (links to VS-112), track to delivery (W3753) and benefits realization (W3747/VS-112.3)

fields.Participants: EEO, Facilities (links to VS-20.3), Store Ops (links to VS-07), DC Ops (links to VS-04), IT/BMS (links to VS-27.2), Sustainability (links to VS-25), Procurement (links to VS-34)
fields.Trigger: ECM delivery (W3753); operations cycle; performance drift (W3747)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-schedule of "schedules, equipment run-times, peak-demand management, and yard/outdoor…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "EEO/Sustainability monitor system-performance impact" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-590 (ensure controlled execution — Energy Audit, Measurement & Conservation Plan Management (PA-120.2).)
- operational: BMS control and SOPs; operational: performance tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Override risk**: Staff override schedules/setpoints, eroding savings; mitigated by BMS control and SOPs
- **Re-commissioning-neglect risk**: Systems drift without re-tuning; mitigated by performance tracking
System Touchpoints: - Facilities (links to VS-20.3); BMS/IoT (links to VS-27.2); store ops (links to VS-07); DC ops (links to VS-04); sustainability (links to VS-25); M&V (links to W3747)

steps.activity: EEO/Facilities optimize building-systems energy performance: HVAC setpoint/scheduling and economizer control, LED/efficient lighting with controls, refrigeration efficiency and door/curtain management, and building-management-system (BMS) tuning; embed in facility operations (links to VS-20.3)

EEO/Facilities/Store Ops manage operational energy SOPs: opening/closing HVAC-lighting schedules, equipment run-times, peak-demand management, and yard/outdoor lighting; ensure store/DC execution (links to VS-07/VS-04)
steps.r: EEO / Facilities / Store Ops / DC Ops

steps.activity: EEO/Sustainability monitor system-performance impact (W3747), identify re-tuning/re-commissioning needs, and integrate with preventive maintenance (links to VS-20.3/W1348 for fleet analogy) to sustain efficiency

fields.Participants: EEO, Store Ops (links to VS-07), HR/L&D (links to VS-19.4/VS-103.2), DC Ops (links to VS-04), Sustainability (links to VS-25), Communications (links to VS-14.3/VS-103.2)
fields.Trigger: Program rollout; performance gap; awareness cycle

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitor store-level energy performance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-590 (ensure controlled execution — Energy Audit, Measurement & Conservation Plan Management (PA-120.2).)
- operational: SOPs and champions; operational: visibility and recognition
Pain Points / Risks: - **Behavior-gap risk**: Technology efficiency eroded by behavior (doors open, lights on); mitigated by SOPs and champions
- **Disengagement risk**: Sites don't see/own their energy performance; mitigated by visibility and recognition
System Touchpoints: - Store ops (links to VS-07); HR/L&D (links to VS-19.4/VS-103.2); DC ops (links to VS-04); communications (links to VS-103.2); performance mgmt (links to VS-33.2); M&V (links to W3747)

steps.activity: EEO/Store Ops/HR embed energy-aware behavior: store/DC energy SOPs, switch-off routines, door/refrigeration discipline, and energy-champion roles at each site; train store/DC staff (links to VS-19.4)

EEO/Sustainability/Communications run energy-engagement: energy-performance visibility to sites, recognition for high-performing sites, and energy-awareness communication (links to VS-103.2); drive a culture of conservation
EEO/Store Ops monitor store-level energy performance (W3747), identify coaching/intervention for outlier sites, and link energy performance to store/DC scorecards (links to VS-33.2)

fields.Participants: EEO, Renewable Program (links to VS-108), Facilities (links to VS-20.3), Procurement (links to VS-34), Treasury (links to VS-18), Sustainability (links to VS-25), Finance (links to VS-17.4)
fields.Trigger: Renewable project (links to VS-108); grid event; tariff strategy

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinate the ECM program" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-export of "export, peak-shaving, demand-response participation, and the economic…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report the combined demand-side + supply-side decarbonization to ESG" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-590 (ensure controlled execution — Energy Audit, Measurement & Conservation Plan Management (PA-120.2).)
- operational: efficiency-first sequencing; operational: grid-interaction optimization
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sizing-mismatch risk**: Generation sized before efficiency, oversized/costlier; mitigated by efficiency-first sequencing
- **Dispatch-suboptimality risk**: Self-generation not optimized against tariff/demand; mitigated by grid-interaction optimization
System Touchpoints: - Renewable (links to VS-108); facilities (links to VS-20.3); treasury (links to VS-18); procurement (links to VS-34); ESG/GHG (links to VS-25/W3466/W192); analytics (links to W3756)

steps.activity: EEO/Renewable integrate demand-side efficiency with own-generation: coordinate the ECM program (reduce demand first) with rooftop-solar/storage deployment (links to VS-108), so generation is sized to optimized demand; sequence efficiency before generation

EEO/Renewable/Treasury manage grid interaction and net-metering (links to VS-108.2): self-consumption vs export, peak-shaving, demand-response participation, and the economic optimization of generation vs grid supply (links to W3742)

EEO/Sustainability attribute renewable generation and efficiency savings to GHG reduction (links to VS-108.3/W3466/W192), and report the combined demand-side + supply-side decarbonization to ESG (links to VS-25) and program analytics (links to W3756)
